Task: 1. Review incoming bug reports and assign to area path and team
Key Rationale: Fully reversible; no blast radius outside Boards; high-frequency daily task.

Task: 2. Generate Bicep templates for new storage accounts from naming docs
Key Rationale: Reversible in branch, but requires human review against policy and naming standards before apply.

Task: 3. Create RBAC role assignments for new team members in prod subscriptions
Key Rationale: Hard Control Point: Production RBAC changes have low reversibility in practice and require human authorization.

Task: 4. Summarize last 7 days of pipeline failures and top 3 patterns
Key Rationale: Read-only multi-source synthesis via ADO MCP server; zero state change.

Task: 5. Update Azure Key Vault secrets when service credentials rotate
Key Rationale: Hard Control Point: Secret and credential operations are never autonomous; requires approved change process.

Task: 6. Write pull request descriptions for infrastructure changes before review
Key Rationale: Draft only; does not bypass branch protection; reduces reviewer cognitive load.

Task: 7. Apply Azure Policy exemptions for approved exception requests
Key Rationale: Hard Control Point: Agents must never autonomously create Azure Policy exemptions or exclusions.

Task: 8. Triage failing unit tests in CI builds and surface probable root cause
Key Rationale: Summaries and hypotheses automated; applying fix recommendation requires committer approval.

Task: 9. Generate sprint summary report for weekly platform status meeting
Key Rationale: Read-only report generation from existing Azure Boards and pipeline run data.

Task: 10. Modify production pipeline variable groups for new deployment target
Key Rationale: Hard Control Point: Production pipeline variable group changes have a tiny rollback window and require change management.
